transcript.content:
<issue>
armhf crash reports have no frames, and the empty backtrace fails the build
The Debian 3.49.15-1 armhf build failed the test suite ([buildd log](https://buildd.debian.org/status/fetch.php?pkg=httrack&arch=armhf&ver=3.49.15-1&stamp=1785404564&raw=0)), leaving armhf the only architecture stuck at Build-Attempted:

```
FAIL: 80_engine-crash-symbolize.test
FAIL: 140_crash-handler.test
# TOTAL: 212   # PASS: 106   # FAIL: 2
```

Both are the same thing: on armhf the crash report carries no frames at all.

```
Caught signal 6

Please report the problem at http://forum.httrack.com
```

`backtrace()` returns 0 there because gcc on armhf does not emit unwind tables by default, and the ARM unwinder has nothing to walk. The published binaries show it: `libhttrack.so.3` armhf has 503 KB of `.text` and exactly 8 bytes of `.ARM.exidx` — one entry. For comparison, `libstdc++.so.6` armhf carries 21 KB of `.ARM.exidx` for 742 KB of text.

Two problems, then. The build has no unwind tables on armhf, so a real crash report from an armhf user is useless; and `hts_print_backtrace()` prints nothing when the frame count is zero, so the report goes silent between "Caught signal" and the closing line, which reads as a handler that died halfway — and the tests, having nothing to match, fail the build.


</issue>

The repository is at /testbed.

input.instruction: In /testbed, find hts_print_backtrace definition (C source) and the build flags in configure.ac / Makefile.am (AM_CFLAGS, CFLAGS additions like -fvisibility). Report the function's full code with file path and line numbers, and the relevant flags lines.

content.text: Add unwind tables flag in configure.ac and a message for empty backtrace.

input.new:
# Unwind tables: needed for backtrace() on targets (e.g. armhf) that lack them by default
AX_CHECK_COMPILE_FLAG([-funwind-tables], [DEFAULT_CFLAGS="$DEFAULT_CFLAGS -funwind-tables"], [], [-Werror])
# No --discard-all: it
